sentence: This project studies how ferroelectric materials, which have reorientable polarization, can be used to enable charge separation and transport.
This project develops methods that help robots predict human intent and adjust their behavior so they can work safely alongside humans.
This project studies the owl limpet to find out how traits related to larval dispersal change as populations colonize habitats.
This project develops methods that help robots understand human intent and keep safe and predictable behavior during teleoperation.
This project studies whether solution-based, single-step fabrication can produce wavelength-selective optical coatings with moisture protection.
This project studies how early life adversity affects the development of social skills in a non-human primate.
This project builds a model of mantle flow and crustal deformation beneath Antarctica to study how they interact with topography.
This project develops artificial intelligence tools that help engineers predict, optimize, and control systems governed by the laws of physics.
This project develops courses and a concentration in cybersecurity grounded in government functions, priorities, and resources.
This project applies nano-cavity enhanced imaging and spectroscopy to study how optically prepared quantum states dissipate in individual nanostructures.
This project studies which plants recover after a hard freeze kills mangroves and how they affect sediment loss or gain.
This project uses relative brain size to study how behavioral flexibility shapes how birds respond to climate change.
This project builds a machine learning control method that helps detect faults in complex systems and adjust the operation of a ventricular assist device.
This project studies how striosomal circuits in rats help weigh cost and reward during decision-making.
This project studies how phytoplankton take up and change different forms of selenium in the ocean.
This project acquires a real-time simulator to study power grid dynamics and test solutions that improve stability, resilience, and cybersecurity.
